youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for strength to keep praying the same prayer.

She: Jesus... Two years. The same prayer. Nothing has moved. 🕯️
She: I stopped editing it. Same words, same chair, same time, every night.
Jesus: I've heard it two thousand times, word for word, and I have never once been tired of it.
She: Then why does it feel like silence? Two years is a long time to talk to a wall.
Jesus: You have never been talking to a wall. Waiting is not a no.
Jesus: So keep asking. The waiting room is not the rejected pile, and I am not keeping score of the months.
